comment: Looper - a bar-synced stereo looper on the MOD firmware's song grid (bar 1 = MIDI Start, or the press that records when no clock runs). Footswitch: with the MIDISTOMP looper services the firmware counts presses (footswitch on the Looper, its on/off CC 64-127) and the Looper drives the LED; without them every on/off flip is a press: press records Length bars when empty, then stops / plays the loop; a double press deletes it. Every action waits for When (IMMED, BEAT, BAR, or CYCLE = the next Amount-bar line). Roll repeats the last 1/2..1/32 of a bar from the next bar line, latched. Mix crossfades live and loop. 12-bit block floating point; stereo whenever Length fits, else mono, else shorter. Tempo changes: the loop stays on the grid (re-synced on 1/32 lines, pitch unchanged).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 493 Breather, 495 GridDly, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper (this pack; 492 and 494 were used by dropped effects, 498 and 499 by the probes). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.
audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Crossfade live <-> loop, DJ style: live full up to 50, loop full from 50, both full at 50. With no loop playing only the live part is heard (Mix 100 = silence). In Mixer Mode's Parallel mode keep it at 100 and use [MIX]'s Crossfade. Default 50.

params.name: Roll
params.comment: OFF, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 of a bar (no triplets). Latched beat repeat: starts on the next bar line and repeats the last slice of the bar that was playing; a new rate takes over on its next line; OFF lands on the running rate's next line, where the loop would have been. Default OFF.

params.name: Length
params.comment: Loop length, shown as 1 to 8 bars. Picked when recording starts: stereo if it fits, else mono, else halved (8 -> 4 -> 2 -> 1). Default 8 bars.

params.name: When
params.comment: When record, stop, play and delete happen (Perform mode's When): IMMED (now; a single press waits 300 ms for a possible double press), BEAT, BAR, CYCLE (the next Amount-bar line counted from bar 1). Default CYCLE.

params.name: Amount
params.comment: Cycle length for When CYCLE, shown as 1 to 16 bars. Length 4 with CYCLE 8 records bars 1-4 of the next 8-bar phrase. Default 8 bars.
